summary: Copley Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-domiciled NYSE-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K after its November 2, 2026 extraordinary general meeting approving amendments to its articles and trust agreement, extending the deadline to consummate an initial business combination from November 2, 2026 to November 2, 2027. The sponsor, Copley Acquisition Sponsors LLC, committed to a promissory note to fund the extension, terms partly described in the October 20 definitive proxy (amended October 30). No target, price or premium is disclosed. Watch monthly extension contributions, trust redemption levels and the 2027 deadline clock.
